nieuw.titel: Keep your dragon threatening the mobile Duke

aanvullingen.voorbeeld: Against Wood Elves with a Treeman Ancient as their level-four wizard, no Forest Dragon and little chaff, he won the first turn and marched his dragon 20 inches into a forest, where it could see beyond the trees. He advanced straight at the slower Ancient to keep it in his arc and shut down its dispelling in combat. The Ancient's defensive saves made the fight lengthy, but he eventually won, restrained and reformed to attack another unit.
aanvullingen.toelichting: This is another example of using a dragon's first turn to march forward towards the opponent.
